description: This file defines the DStreamCheckpointData class used for managing checkpoint data in Spark Streaming DStreams, including updating, cleaning up, restoring, and serialization of checkpoint files.

classes.name: DStreamCheckpointData
classes.description: A class for managing checkpoint data of a DStream, including updating checkpoint files, cleanup of old files, and restoring checkpointed RDDs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates checkpoint data with current checkpoint files from the DStream at a given time.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Deletes old checkpoint files that are no longer needed after a checkpoint of a specific time.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores checkpointed RDDs from checkpoint files during recovery.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the checkpoint data.

methods.name: writeObject
methods.description: Serializes the object, ensuring checkpoint graph is in progress.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Deserializes the object and initializes internal state.
